source_title: An InventHelp 123Invent Client Develops Centralized Sonar System Idea for Fishing Boats (LBT-9887)
source_excerpt:
PITTSBURGH , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- "I spend a lot of time fishing, and I wanted to create a better way to connect and manage sonar electronics on a boat," said an inventor from Zumbro Falls, Minn. "My idea would use one central system to support multiple screens and connections, which could help reduce cable runs and improve the fishing electronics setup."
InventHelp Invention Spotlight: NEXT GENERATION SONAR UNIT Could Help Simplify Boat Electronics
Helps reduce the need for multiple separate sonar units
Provides a more organized marine electronics setup
Offers improved convenience for anglers using multiple displays InventHelp Client's Invention for Marine Electronics
Fishing boats often rely on multiple sonar units, network hubs and long cable runs, which could create clutter, increase costs and lead to connection problems. The NEXT GENERATION SONAR UNIT idea would offer a centralized marine electronics system that could help boaters manage sonar, mapping and accessory connections through one main unit.
Licensing Opportunities for InventHelp 123Invent Client:
The invention is available for licensing or sale to manufacturers or marketers who may wish to bring it to market.
